summary: Alpha Tau Medical Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting collaboration and supply agreements with Tolmar International for exclusive U.S. commercialization of Alpha DaRT for prostate cancer, including a $15M upfront manufacturing payment and up to $161.5M in milestones, plus a concurrent private placement of 1,668,057 ordinary shares at $11.99/share (25% premium to VWAP) for $20M gross proceeds. The filing is a routine entry into commercial partnership and capital-raising, not a special-situation M&A, tender offer, or corporate restructuring. It is classified as None because the event is an ordinary collaborative and funding arrangement without change-of-control or special-situations characteristics.
